title: Study of LED Phototherapy for Musculoligamentous Lesions
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether LED phototherapy using combined red and near infrared light (approved: Ministry of Health of Russian Federation No. 29/06070997/1080-00, EUROCAT Certificate No. CP033321-IV) is effective in the treatment of musculoligamentous lesions in physiotherapy practice
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of acute or chronic musculoligamentous lesion
* Must be able to understand instructions and fill in auto administered questionnaires
* Informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Use of oral corticosteroids or corticosteroid injections
* Systemic diseases
* General contraindications for phototherapy
